title: Isolation and Culture of Mouse Islet Cells with Flow Cytometry Analysis
author: Sarah Popp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmgjk3un

steps.title: Prepare islets in PBS
steps.instruction: Transfer isolated mouse islets to a 15 mL tube, remove excess medium with a pipette, resuspend in approximately 10–15 mL PBS containing 3 mM EDTA, centrifuge at 249 g, then carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Digest islets with Accutase
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in pre‑thawed Accutase at 250 µL per 500 islets, place the tube in a 37 °C water bath for 10 min, gently tapping the pellet at 4 min and 8 min to aid resuspension.

steps.title: Mechanically dissociate islets
steps.instruction: Pipette the suspension up and down 10–15 times using a 1 mL single‑channel pipette to dissociate the islets.

steps.title: Terminate digestion and wash
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL culture medium to each tube to stop the Accutase reaction, then centrifuge for 5 min at 249 g.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in beta medium
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in beta cell culture medium at 500 µL per 500 islets, and determine cell density with a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Plate cells
steps.instruction: Aliquot 4–8 × 10⁴ cells into each well of a culture plate, bring the volume to 200 µL with beta cell culture medium, centrifuge the plate at 249 g, and remove the supernatant by flicking.

steps.title: Add experimental treatments
steps.instruction: Add heparin or heparan sulfate mimetics (e.g., PI‑88) to achieve a final concentration of 50 µg/mL in the 200 µL well volume; keep control wells in medium alone.

steps.title: Assess viability by Calcein/PI
steps.instruction: Perform Calcein‑AM/Propidium Iodide staining on day 0 and day 2 as follows:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture plate at 110–173 g for 3 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 0.04 µM Calcein‑AM, 100 µL per well; incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Add 100 µL culture medium, centrifuge at 110–173 g, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 2.5 µg/mL Propidium Iodide, 100 µL per well; incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Add 100 µL PBS, centrifuge at 110–173 g, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 100 µL PBS for flow cytometry.

Analyze data with FlowJo software (version 10.0.7, TreeStar Inc.). Viable β‑cells are Calcein⁺ PI⁻; damaged β‑cells are Calcein⁺ PI⁺; dead cells are Calcein⁻ PI⁺. Excitation/emission: Calcein‑AM 494 nm/517 nm, PI 493 nm/636 nm.

steps.title: Assess viability by SYTOX Green
steps.instruction: Perform SYTOX Green staining for H₂O₂‑induced death on day 0 and day 2 as follows:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture plate at 110–173 g for 3 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 µL of 30 % H₂O₂ or culture medium; incubate for 5 min.
Add 100 µL culture medium, centrifuge at 300 g for 3 min, discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 31.25 nM SYTOX Green (1/160,000 dilution of stock), 100 µL per well; incubate at 37 °C for 15 min.
Add 100 µL PBS, centrifuge at 110–173 g for 3 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 100 µL PBS for flow cytometry.
Analyze data with FlowJo software (version 10.0.7, TreeStar Inc.). SYTOX Green⁺ cells are dead/damaged; excitation/emission: 504 nm/523 nm.
